key_impacts: Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Two New Jersey refineries were shut down, resulting in the loss of 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD regional operating capacity.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to power outage.
MTA river crossings were damaged by Sandy.
Storm surge flooding in New York City exceeded 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
evidence_snippets: Its arrival on the evening of October 29 coincided with high tide and generated a massive surge in New York Harbor.
Two refineries in Port Reading and Linden, New Jersey, were shut down, causing a 26.3% capacity loss.
